findings.label: Inactive STT mock contract
findings.finding: STT_PROVIDER=mock is ignored while AWS_MOCK_MODE=false makes audio processing invoke the real Lambda client, and the documented initial deployment creates no STT function.
findings.action: Land the selective STT adapter, gate audio processing, or provide a real fallback before enabling deploys.

findings.label: Failed image becomes boot default
findings.finding: .backend-image is updated before the candidate passes its health check, so a failed deployment becomes the image selected by aives.service on later boots.
findings.action: Persist .backend-image only after health succeeds and preserve the previous known-good tag on failure.

findings.label: Unbounded Bedrock model scope
findings.finding: The EC2 role can invoke every Bedrock foundation model in every region rather than only the configured Nova/Titan resources.
findings.action: Restrict access to the configured inference profiles and required Nova/Titan backing-model ARNs, or use a validated Terraform ARN allowlist.

findings.label: Unused IAM capabilities
findings.finding: The EC2 and GitHub policies grant actions absent from the committed application and deploy workflow call graphs, including unused Lambda, CloudFront, SSM, backup-listing, and DynamoDB operations.
findings.action: Remove the unused actions until code that needs them lands.

findings.label: Runtime validation pending
findings.finding: AWS apply, AL2023 bootstrap, EBS mounting, Docker health, SSM deployment, GitHub Actions, and backup/restore behavior remain unexecuted under the agreed code-only constraints.
findings.action: Exercise these paths with non-root credentials before setting AWS_DEPLOY_ENABLED=true.
